federal.issue_statement: The individual is receiving excessive calls from North Star Receivables, involving harassment through multiple calls each day, including calls made at work.

elements.element_description: The debt collector engages in conduct that could be considered harassing or abusive, such as calling excessively.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The individual keeps a notebook of every call received from North Star Receivables.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The individual has not received any court papers or lawsuits.

fact_mappings.fact_text: This communication is from a debt collector.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The debt is owed to Granite Bay Funding LLC.

elements.element_description: The calls adversely affect the consumer's ability to conduct personal matters, including employment.

fact_mappings.fact_text: North Star Receivables called the individual at 7:15 in the morning.
